The other actual options are different early Soviet economic initiatives: P6 labels the first plan1928–1932; P8 distinguishes NEP in pre-mid1950s economic construction; official collectivization page covers1930. absoluteLevel.ground: FAIL for frozen HARD. The exact prompt supplies1965, Soviet economic reform and expanded enterprise rights. The three alternatives are the First Five-Year Plan, NEP and collectivization: the plan is1928–1932 (retained P6); the NEP context belongs to early post-Civil-War economic construction before the mid1950s (retained P8 narrative); collectivization is explicitly documented in1930. They do not offer competing1960s enterprise-management reforms. Recognizing the broad Soviet chronology eliminates all three without knowing a specific1965 mechanism or making a substantive multistep inference. The correct label alone explicitly says reforma; the other labels are a plan, a policy and an agrarian process. All are Soviet economic-history terms and grammatically feminine, but that broad shared topic is insufficient to make this a HARD discrimination. At most this exact set demonstrates thematic recall of a standard named reform; no frozen-level reassignment is authorized.

correctNoteExtraFact.ground: These are explicit separate bullets at P9 L58 and L60, while the asked fact is expansion of enterprise rights and the answer is the reform’s name. They teach own-reform content beyond merely restating the key.
